prompt:

Asset type: landscape 16:9 full-bleed desktop pizzeria ordering website background, photograph only.

Scene/backdrop: dark soot-aged brick pizza oven. A softly blurred authentic arched brick oven opening with a restrained amber wood fire occupies the FAR LEFT QUARTER, toward the upper left. Subject: one beautiful believable mozzarella and tomato pizza, bubbling cheese, crisp irregular golden charred crust, a few basil leaves, no meat. Large close crop on the RIGHTMOST THIRD, predominantly lower right, cropped beyond bottom and right edge. Wood grain of pizza peel visible near crust.

No pizza or flames intrude into the central vertical axis. Oven arch/fire only far left, pizza only far right, believable depth and continuous photographic scene.
Lighting/mood: warm amber oven light, vibrant tomato and cheese, tactile crust, cozy pizzeria atmosphere, high-quality editorial food photography, natural dark center, visible warm material details.
Color palette: warm brick, toasted honey crust, tomato red, ivory cheese, amber fire, dark brown-black masonry.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: photo only, NO interface, NO text, NO logo, NO branding, NO people, NO hands, NO lettering, NO buttons, NO black serving plate, no metallic gold material, no luxury tableware, no illustration, no watermark. Keep the pizza vividly appetizing.
